study type: Secondary data analysis of three waves of the Pakistan Demographic and Health Surveys (PDHS)
cohort: Women in Pakistan who had delivered a child during the last 5 years preceding each wave of PDHS (2006, 2013, 2018)
finding: While maternal PNC utilization showed an upward linear trend in Pakistan from 2006 to 2018, newborn PNC utilization showed a non-linear trend with a decrease in 2018; several individual, community, and institutional level determinants were associated with PNC utilization.
mod_finding: Women who had caesarean sections had higher odds of both maternal and newborn PNC utilization.
